title: Odd sign-product equation tester
statement: For each natural number $n$, define a tester for functions from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the signs. It samples two sign vectors and a target sign uniformly, queries at the first two vectors and at the pointwise product of those vectors scaled by the target sign, and accepts exactly when all three answers are present and their product equals the target sign.
